name: Twilight Post
summary: Twilight Post holds the Twilight's Hammer in a fortified camp in northwestern Silithus. Far west of Cenarion Hold and northwest of Twilight Base Camp, its cultists use wind stones to contact otherworldly forces. Adventurers here face zealous defenders and the stones that serve their rites.

sections.title: A Bastion of Elemental Zealotry
sections.body:
Twilight Post is a fortified outpost in northwestern Silithus. Heavily armed defenders and ritualists fill the camp, among them Twilight Avengers, Geolords, and Stonecallers. Twilight Keeper Mayna leads them, with the rare fanatic Twilight Lord Everun at her side.

At the heart of the post stand Lesser, regular, and Greater Wind Stones. Through dark rites and communion with the elements, the cultists use them to call elemental horrors from realms beyond and bind them. Such rites threaten the fragile peace the Cenarion Circle keeps in the region.

faq.answer: Twilight Post stands in far northwestern Silithus, well west of Cenarion Hold and northwest of the larger Twilight Base Camp.
The Twilight's Hammer cult occupies Twilight Post. Twilight Keeper Mayna and Twilight Lord Everun are stationed there, guarded by ranks of Twilight Avengers, Geolords, and Stonecallers.

faq.q: What are the wind stones found in the camp?
faq.answer: The Lesser, regular, and Greater Wind Stones are arcane conduits. The Twilight's Hammer uses them to summon and bind elemental creatures to its service.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer operating in Silithus?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer has flocked to Silithus to awaken and commune with ancient, dark powers beneath the sands. Its elemental summonings also bolster the cult's ranks.

angles.text: As a shaman, you know the Twilight's Hammer twists the sacred communion of the elements. At outposts like this, its cultists use wind stones to summon and bind spirits by force.
As a druid, you know the Cenarion Circle watches the cult's outposts closely. Its dark elemental rites threaten Silithus's fragile, scarred balance.
